chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم walked behind a جنازة, and it was said to him: “O Messenger of Allah, why are you walking behind it?” He said: “Indeed, I saw the angels walking in front of it, and we are followers of them.”

key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةَ: the angels, described as walking ahead of the funeral
key_terms.تَبَعٌ: followers; those who come after and follow
key_terms.جَنَازَةٍ: a funeral bier or funeral procession
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, addressed directly in the report

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم walk behind a funeral procession?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم walked behind a funeral bier because he saw the angels walking ahead of it. It highlights the sanctity of funeral processions and indicates a prophetic practice connected to reverence for the deceased and awareness of the unseen.
